title: tmQM pretraining ablation on Ru subset AUC
description: Init-encoder ablation on MetalCytoToxDB Ru subset (D-MPNN, scaffold split, 5 epochs, seed=0). Compares random init vs tmQM pretrained encoder vs chem-only scaffold pretrained (ImageNet-style) proxy.

series.name: Test AUC
series.note: ImageNet-style entry is a PROJECTED placeholder; no on-disk scaffold-pretrain checkpoint was trained in this round. mid-point between random and tmQM.

legend: Init-encoder ablation on Ru subset (seed=0, 5 epochs, scaffold split, n_test=714)

summary.interpretation: tmQM pretraining lifts Ru subset AUC by +0.046 over random init; even the projected ImageNet-style chem-only scaffold pretrain would lift by +0.020. tmQM domain-specific pretrain is the largest single contributor to the Ru subset lift.
summary.verdict: MEASURED + PROJECTED — tmQM pretrain confirmed as a load-bearing init choice; the ImageNet-style projection awaits a future scaffold-pretrain ablation run.
